name: Psychic Detective Series Vol. 2: Memories
original_name: サイキック・ディテクティブ・シリーズ Vol.2 メモリーズ
source:
The psychic detective Katsuya Furuyagi cannot forget his past. Looking at the photo in his office, he recalls Rieka, the woman who won't leave him in his dreams. At that moment, a young girl enters the office; seemingly distressed, she utters a strange request: "erase the memory of my father". Intrigued, Furuyagi uses his psychic abilities to travel to the past and relive memories and people's fates once again.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/psychic-detective-series-vol2-memories]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
灵能侦探降矢木胜也始终无法忘记过去。望着办公室里的照片，他想起莉绘香，那个在梦中挥之不去的女人。就在此时，一名神色不安的少女走进办公室，提出一项奇怪的请求：“请抹去我关于父亲的记忆。”好奇心被勾起的降矢木运用灵能力回到过去，再次亲历种种记忆与人们的命运。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/psychic-detective-series-vol2-memories]Moby Games[/url]]
